news.title: Football: India seek World Cup feel with three expensive friendlies
news.lede: This is a Mint Premium article gifted to you. Playing in a Fifa World Cup against world-class opponents being a distant dream, India have apparently opted for a shortcut to get a feel of it. In the September-October Fifa international window, India’s senior men’s national team will host three teams that featured in the World Cup 2026 that concluded in July. While the first match is against Panama (Fifa ranking 44) on 25 September at Bengaluru’s Sree Kanteerava Stadium, the other two are at Kolkata’s Salt Lake Stadium (VYBK) against five-time World Cup winners Brazil (ranked 5) and Uruguay (ranked 20) on 3 and 6 October, respectively.

news.title: Mighty Sundowns show Africa how global football is done
news.lede: Mamelodi Sundowns may be the African champions but after yesterday’s performance, they are slowly but surely starting to prove that they could be more than that and are setting the benchmark of African football at this point. Masandawana represented Africa once again at a Fifa competition when they went pound for pound against the back-to-back Asian champions, Al Ahli Saudi, at Loftus Versfeld Stadium in Tshwane. The Brazilians unleashed their “shoe-shine and piano” when they beat the Saudi Arabian giants 2-1 to lift the Fifa African Asian-Pacific Cup and advance to the semi-finals of the Fifa Intercontinental Cup. Sundowns will now face either Mexican club Toluca or the team that wins the Copa Libertadores in South America in the semi-finals.

news.title: Italy: Mancini calls up nine newcomers after World Cup 2026 failure
news.lede: In his first squad since returning to lead Italy, Roberto Mancini has called up nine uncapped players in a group of 34 to launch the Nations League. Roberto Mancini has called up nine uncapped players in a squad of 34 for Italy’s first four matches in the Nations League. This list, published on Friday, September 18, marks the coach’s first selection since returning to lead the Azzurri following the team’s failure to qualify for the 2026 World Cup. Massimo Pessina, Daniele Ghilardi, Michael Kayode, Eddy Kouadio, Issa Doumbia, Alessandro Romano, Sebastiano Esposito, Antonio Vergara, and Mohamed Alì Zoma are set to make their debut in the senior national team.

news.title: Hans-Joachim Watzke reveals that he considered making Thomas Tuchel Germany coach after 2022 World Cup
news.lede: It seems Germany could have had a change in coach sooner after the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Hans-Joachim Watzke, vice-president of the German Football Association (DFB), revealed to Sky Sport (as captured by @iMiaSanMia) that after Germany’s group stage exit in Qatar, he had considered replacing then-national coach Hansi Flick with Thomas Tuchel. Tuchel was without a job at the time after being sacked by Chelsea. We were knocked out quite miserably in Qatar.

news.title: Casablanca will host 2030 World Cup final, says Moroccan federation chief
news.lede: The 2030 World Cup final will be held in Casablanca, the President of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation was reported as saying by Spanish news agency EFE on Thursday. Soccer's world governing body FIFA has yet to announce the venue of the final, with Spain and Morocco in a heated battle to host soccer's biggest showpiece match. "The province of Benslimane will have the honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final," Fouzi Lekjaa told a political party event in Bouznika, Morocco on Thursday, EFE reported. Benslimane is a city 60km from Casablanca and the site of the $12-billion Hassan II stadium, which is being built for the World Cup with a projected capacity of 115,000.

news.title: This college football team just adopted Norway's World Cup Viking Row
news.lede: Norway's Viking Row was one of the most viral fan traditions of the 2026 World Cup. Now, two months later, it has officially made its way into American college football. The University of Minnesota debuted its own version of the synchronized rowing chant at its season opener at Huntington Bank Stadium, with the student section sitting in rows and mimicking the same exaggerated rowing motion that Norwegian fans made famous this summer. Former Gophers linebacker Kamal Martin led the chant before kickoff, keeping one of the World Cup's biggest fan traditions going long after the tournament ended.

news.title: Ronaldinho to make football comeback aged 46
news.lede: More than a decade after his last professional appearance, Brazilian superstar Ronaldinho is set for a comeback. The former world player of the year is to play in Italy’s third tier. While Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are still playing at 39 and 41 respectively, most football fans thought Ronaldinho belonged to another footballing era. That all changed in June, when Italian Serie C club, Ravenna, announced that the former Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and AC Milan forward would play for them in the upcoming season.
